grammar: prep. & adv. 超出；在较远的一边；在更远处
collocations: beyond the city limits; beyond repair; far beyond the Moon
commonMistake: beyond 可接名词表示“超出范围”，也可作副词表示“在更远处”；比较数量时不要写 beyond than。

example.english: The small village lies beyond the mountains.
example.chinese: 那个小村庄在山脉的另一边。

application.prompt: The signal was too weak to reach the station ___ the hills. A. between B. beyond
application.solution: B。解析：beyond the hills 表示“在山丘另一边”；between 需要说明两者之间。

collocations: a space mission; mission to explore Mars; complete a mission
commonMistake: mission 是可数名词，常用 a mission to do sth 表示“执行某项任务去做某事”；missionary 是传教士，不是任务。

example.english: The crew began its mission to collect samples from the Moon.
example.chinese: 机组人员开始执行从月球采集样本的任务。

application.prompt: The scientists' main ___ is to search for signs of water on Mars. A. missionary B. mission
application.solution: B。解析：search for water 是科学家的 mission（任务）；missionary 指传教士。

collocations: look through a telescope; a powerful telescope; telescope lens
commonMistake: telescope 前常用 look through，表示透过望远镜观察；look at a telescope 只表示看着望远镜本身。

example.english: We looked through a telescope and saw the rings of Saturn.
example.chinese: 我们通过望远镜看到了土星环。

application.prompt: To observe the distant moon, the students took turns looking ___ a telescope. A. across B. through
application.solution: B。解析：look through a telescope 是“通过望远镜观察”；across 表示横穿或在对面。

collocations: a Mars rover; rover mission; robotic rover
commonMistake: rover 在航天语境中指能在行星表面移动的探测车；它不在轨道上绕行，那是 satellite 的工作。

example.english: The rover sent photographs from the rocky surface of Mars.
example.chinese: 探测车从火星岩石表面传回了照片。

application.prompt: The robot moved over the planet's surface and collected soil. It was a ___. A. rover B. telescope
application.solution: A。解析：在行星表面移动并采集土壤的是 rover（探测车）；telescope 用来观测远处天体。

grammar: adj. 载人的；需人操作的
collocations: a manned spacecraft; a manned mission; manned by a trained crew
commonMistake: manned 是形容词，表示有人员乘坐或操作；其反义词是 unmanned，写作时注意不是名词 man 的复数。

example.english: The country hopes to send a manned spacecraft to the Moon.
example.chinese: 这个国家希望向月球发射一艘载人航天器。

application.prompt: The flight will carry astronauts, so it is a ___ mission. A. man B. manned
application.solution: B。解析：载有宇航员的任务是 manned mission（载人任务）；man 是“男人”或“人”的名词。

grammar: v. 发射；发起；n. 发射；上市
collocations: launch a rocket; launch a campaign; the launch of a satellite
commonMistake: launch 可作动词或名词；名词前用 the launch of，不能说 the launch a satellite。

example.english: The space agency will launch a weather satellite next month.
example.chinese: 航天机构下个月将发射一颗气象卫星。

application.prompt: The rocket ___ at dawn after the final safety check. A. launched B. launch
application.solution: A。解析：主语 rocket 叙述过去的发射，需用过去式 launched；launch 是原形。

grammar: adj. 失重的；无重量感的
collocations: feel weightless; a weightless environment; weightless in space
commonMistake: weightless 是形容词，由 weight 加 -less 构成；名词为 weightlessness，表示失重状态。

example.english: Astronauts float because they feel weightless in orbit.
example.chinese: 宇航员在轨道上会漂浮，因为他们感到失重。

application.prompt: The astronauts experienced ___ as they floated around the cabin. A. weight B. weightlessness
application.solution: B。解析：experience 后接名词 weightlessness 表示“失重状态”；weight 是重量。

collocations: body movement; movement of the planets; a movement for peace
commonMistake: movement 是名词，动词是 move；它既可指身体动作，也可指社会运动，不能在名词前误用 moving。

example.english: The camera recorded every movement of the tiny robot.
example.chinese: 摄像机记录了这个小机器人的每一个动作。

application.prompt: The sensor detects any ___ inside the empty laboratory. A. movement B. move
application.solution: A。解析：any 后需要名词 movement，表示“任何动作”；move 是动词。

collocations: be fast asleep; fall asleep; sound asleep
commonMistake: asleep 通常作表语，不能直接放在名词前；可说 a sleeping child，但不能说 an asleep child。

example.english: The baby was asleep before the train left the station.
example.chinese: 火车离站前，宝宝已经睡着了。

application.prompt: The lights were still on, but nobody answered the alarm because everyone in the cabin was ___. A. sleepy B. asleep
application.solution: B。解析：be asleep 表示“睡着了”；sleepy 表示“困倦的”，不一定已经入睡。

collocations: fall asleep quickly; fall asleep in class; help sb fall asleep
commonMistake: fall asleep 表示从清醒变为睡着，过去式是 fell asleep；不要说 fall to asleep。

example.english: I fell asleep while listening to the quiet rain.
example.chinese: 听着安静的雨声，我睡着了。

application.prompt: The astronaut was tired after training and ___ soon after dinner. A. fell asleep B. fell to asleep
application.solution: A。解析：fell asleep 是 fall asleep 的过去式，表示“入睡”；该短语中不加 to。

grammar: v. 系上；束紧；n. 领带；平局
collocations: tie a rope around sth; tie A to B; a tie in the final
commonMistake: tie 作动词表示系紧，过去式和过去分词是 tied；表示比赛平局也是名词 tie。

example.english: Tie the safety line to the rail before you climb.
example.chinese: 攀爬前先把安全绳系在栏杆上。

application.prompt: The climber ___ the rope securely to a strong metal ring. A. tie B. tied
application.solution: B。解析：句子叙述已完成的动作，需用 tie 的过去式 tied；tie 是原形。

collocations: study geology; geology of Mars; geological survey
commonMistake: geology 研究地球或其他行星的组成和结构；geography 研究地表与人类活动，二者学科不同。

example.english: Her geology class studied rocks collected from the desert.
example.chinese: 她的地质课研究了从沙漠采集的岩石。

application.prompt: The study of a planet's rocks and internal structure is called ___. A. geology B. geologist
application.solution: A。解析：geology 是研究行星岩石与内部结构的“地质学”；geologist 指地质学家。

collocations: launch a satellite; a weather satellite; satellite image
commonMistake: satellite 可指人造卫星，也可指围绕行星运行的天然卫星；月球是地球的 natural satellite。

example.english: The satellite sends weather data back to Earth every hour.
example.chinese: 这颗卫星每小时向地球发送气象数据。

application.prompt: A ___ in orbit can send storm images to weather stations. A. satellite B. submarine
application.solution: A。解析：在轨道上发送风暴图像的是 satellite（卫星）；submarine 是潜水艇。

grammar: adj. 疯狂的；不理智的；着迷的
collocations: be crazy about space; a crazy idea; drive sb crazy
commonMistake: be crazy about sth 表示“非常喜欢某物”；crazy 是形容词，副词是 crazily，不能用 crazy 修饰动词。

example.english: My sister is crazy about documentaries on space travel.
example.chinese: 我妹妹特别喜欢太空旅行纪录片。

application.prompt: Ravi is ___ about astronomy and reads about planets every night. A. crazily B. crazy
application.solution: B。解析：be crazy about 是“对……着迷”；be 后用形容词 crazy。

collocations: a human being; human beings need water; protect human life
commonMistake: human being 是可数短语，复数为 human beings；human 可单独作形容词或名词，泛指人类时也可说 humans。

example.english: Every human being needs clean air and safe water.
example.chinese: 每个人都需要干净的空气和安全的饮用水。

application.prompt: The new planet may have conditions that could support a ___ one day. A. human being B. humanity
application.solution: A。解析：support a human being 指“支持一个人类个体生存”；humanity 是抽象的“人类/人性”。

collocations: require a passport; require sb to do sth; require further study
commonMistake: require 可接名词或 sb to do sth；名词形式是 requirement，不能说 require to someone。

example.english: The research station requires visitors to wear protective glasses.
example.chinese: 研究站要求访客佩戴防护眼镜。

application.prompt: The safety rule ___ all crew members to fasten their belts. A. requirement B. requires
application.solution: B。解析：主语 rule 为单数，谓语用 requires；requirement 是名词。

collocations: cancel a meeting; cancel a flight; cancel the order
commonMistake: cancel 的过去式美式常写 canceled，英式常写 cancelled；名词 cancellation 双写 l。

example.english: The launch team cancelled the test because of strong winds.
example.chinese: 由于风力太强，发射团队取消了测试。

application.prompt: The airline had to ___ the flight when the storm closed the airport. A. cancel B. cancellation
application.solution: A。解析：had to 后接动词原形 cancel；cancellation 是名词。

collocations: publish an article; publish a book; publish results
commonMistake: publish 是动词，名词 publication 指出版或出版物，publisher 指出版商；不要把 publish 与 public 混淆。

example.english: The scientist published her findings in a space research journal.
example.chinese: 这位科学家在太空研究期刊上发表了她的发现。

application.prompt: The magazine will ___ an interview with the astronaut next week. A. publication B. publish
application.solution: B。解析：will 后接动词原形 publish，表示“刊登”；publication 是名词。

collocations: a space rocket; launch a rocket; rocket engine
commonMistake: rocket 是可数名词；作动词时表示“飞速上升”，常说 prices rocket，注意与 spacecraft（航天器）区别。

example.english: The rocket carried a small research satellite into orbit.
example.chinese: 火箭把一颗小型研究卫星送入轨道。

application.prompt: The ___ blasted off from the launch site carrying the research capsule. A. rocket B. rover
application.solution: A。解析：从发射场升空并携带舱体的是 rocket（火箭）；rover 是在地面移动的探测车。

collocations: discover an exoplanet; an exoplanet orbiting a distant star; exoplanet research
commonMistake: exoplanet 指太阳系以外、围绕其他恒星运行的行星；它不是漂浮在恒星之间的普通太空岩石。

example.english: Astronomers found an exoplanet orbiting a star far from our solar system.
example.chinese: 天文学家发现一颗围绕远离太阳系的恒星运行的系外行星。

application.prompt: A planet orbiting a star other than the Sun is called an ___. A. exoplanet B. asteroid
application.solution: A。解析：围绕太阳系外恒星运行的行星是 exoplanet（系外行星）；asteroid 是小行星。

collocations: solar energy; solar panels; the solar system
commonMistake: solar 是形容词，常修饰 energy、panel 或 system；sunny 表示天气晴朗，不用来指能源来源。

example.english: The school installed solar panels on the roof to save electricity.
example.chinese: 学校在屋顶安装了太阳能板以节省电力。

application.prompt: The village uses ___ power to run its water pumps. A. sunny B. solar
application.solution: B。解析：solar power 表示“太阳能”；sunny 描述天气阳光充足。

collocations: a Greek god; ancient gods; the god of the sea
commonMistake: god 泛指神明时通常小写，特定宗教中的神名可按名称大写为 God；大写需依据具体语境。

example.english: In the story, the sailors prayed to a Greek god for safe travel.
example.chinese: 故事里，水手们向一位希腊神明祈求航行平安。

application.prompt: The museum displayed a statue of an ancient Roman ___. A. god B. God
application.solution: A。解析：a 后的小写 god 表示古罗马的一位神明；句子不是专有神名。

grammar: adj. 神秘的；难以解释的
collocations: a mysterious signal; mysterious lights; remain mysterious
commonMistake: mysterious 是形容词，名词是 mystery，副词是 mysteriously；不能用 mystery 直接修饰 signal。

example.english: A mysterious light appeared above the desert and disappeared quickly.
example.chinese: 一束神秘的光出现在沙漠上空，很快又消失了。

application.prompt: Scientists are investigating a ___ signal that repeats every hour. A. mystery B. mysterious
application.solution: B。解析：signal 前需要形容词 mysterious；mystery 是名词。

collocations: a spacecraft in orbit; launch a spacecraft; unmanned spacecraft
commonMistake: spacecraft 单复数同形，one spacecraft 与 several spacecraft 都不加 s；它是更广义的航天器，spaceship 常指载人飞船。

example.english: The spacecraft sent its first image of the distant planet.
example.chinese: 航天器发回了那颗遥远行星的第一张图像。

application.prompt: Two ___ entered orbit around the planet to collect data. A. spacecraft B. spacecrafts
application.solution: A。解析：spacecraft 的复数仍是 spacecraft；该词不加 s。

grammar: 短语 以防万一；如果
collocations: take a map in case we get lost; in case of rain; just in case
commonMistake: in case 后可接完整从句，in case of 后接名词；它表示预防，不等同于 if（如果）。

example.english: Take a flashlight in case the path is dark after sunset.
example.chinese: 带上手电筒，以防日落后小路太暗。

application.prompt: The astronauts packed extra water ___ the supply system stopped working. A. because B. in case
application.solution: B。解析：in case 引出需要预先防备的情况“供水系统停止工作”；because 表示已经发生的原因。

collocations: a wooden board; notice board; write on the board
commonMistake: board 可指木板、公告板或董事会；登机用 board 作动词，短语为 board a plane，不说 board on a plane。

example.english: The teacher wrote the launch times on the board.
example.chinese: 老师把发射时间写在了板上。

application.prompt: The crew checked the flight plan displayed on the ___ beside the cabin door. A. board B. aboard
application.solution: A。解析：显示计划的牌板是 board（公告板）；aboard 是副词或介词“在交通工具上”。

grammar: 短语 在船、火车或飞机上
collocations: passengers on board; welcome on board; an instrument on board
commonMistake: on board 表示已经在交通工具上；board 作为动词可直接接交通工具，如 board the plane，不在 board 后再加 on。

example.english: There were twelve astronauts on board the research spacecraft.
example.chinese: 研究航天器上有十二名宇航员。

application.prompt: The captain welcomed all passengers ___ before the aircraft left the gate. A. on aboard B. on board
application.solution: B。解析：on board 表示“在飞机上”；on aboard 把两种表达混在一起，是错误搭配。

collocations: one billion stars; billions of years; a billion-dollar mission
commonMistake: 确切数字前 billion 不加 s、不接 of；表示不确切的大量时用 billions of。

example.english: The galaxy contains billions of stars.
example.chinese: 这个星系包含数十亿颗恒星。

application.prompt: The telescope cost three ___ dollars to build. A. billion B. billions of
application.solution: A。解析：确切数字 three 后用 billion，不加复数 s，也不加 of。

collocations: one trillion; trillions of particles; a trillion-dollar economy
commonMistake: 确切数字前 trillion 不加 s；表示数量极大但不精确时用 trillions of。

example.english: A trillion is one thousand times a billion.
example.chinese: 一万亿是一千个十亿。

application.prompt: The data centre stored more than one ___ bits of information. A. trillions B. trillion
application.solution: B。解析：one 后用单数数词 trillion；不能写 one trillions。

collocations: cooperate closely; cooperate on a project; international cooperation
commonMistake: cooperate 的名词是 cooperation；英式拼法 co-operate 也可见，注意动词拼写中有两个 o。

example.english: The two research teams cooperated to study the planet's atmosphere.
example.chinese: 两个研究团队合作研究了这颗行星的大气层。

application.prompt: The scientists agreed to ___ on the next stage of the experiment. A. cooperate B. cooperation
application.solution: A。解析：to 后接动词原形 cooperate；cooperation 是名词。

collocations: cooperate with scientists; cooperate with another team; cooperate with sb on sth
commonMistake: cooperate with 后接人、团队或机构；不能说 cooperate to someone。

example.english: Our school will cooperate with the local observatory on a stargazing event.
example.chinese: 我们学校将与当地天文台合作举办观星活动。

application.prompt: The engineers will ___ the university to test the new antenna. A. cooperate to B. cooperate with
application.solution: B。解析：cooperate with the university 表示“与大学合作”；with 引出合作对象。

collocations: a distant galaxy; the Milky Way Galaxy; galaxy cluster
commonMistake: galaxy 指由恒星、气体和尘埃组成的星系；宇宙包含许多 galaxies，不能把 galaxy 与 universe 当作同义词。

example.english: The telescope captured a bright galaxy billions of light-years away.
example.chinese: 望远镜拍到一个距离数十亿光年的明亮星系。

application.prompt: The Milky Way is the ___ that contains our Solar System. A. galaxy B. universe
application.solution: A。解析：银河系是包含太阳系的 galaxy（星系）；universe 指包含所有星系的整个宇宙。

collocations: set foot on the Moon; never set foot on the island; the first person to set foot on Mars
commonMistake: 固定短语用 set foot on + 地点；set 的过去式仍是 set，不变形。

example.english: No human being has set foot on Mars yet.
example.chinese: 还没有人类踏上过火星。

application.prompt: The explorer was the first member of the team to ___ the icy island. A. set feet on B. set foot on
application.solution: B。解析：固定说法是 set foot on，foot 用单数；set feet on 不符合该短语结构。

collocations: use your imagination; a vivid imagination; beyond imagination
commonMistake: imagination 是不可数名词，动词是 imagine，形容词是 imaginative；通常不说 an imagination 表示一般想象力。

example.english: The writer used her imagination to create a world under the ocean.
example.chinese: 作家发挥想象力，创造了一个海底世界。

application.prompt: The children's model of a space station showed great ___. A. imagination B. imagine
application.solution: A。解析：great 后需要名词 imagination，表示“丰富的想象力”；imagine 是动词。

collocations: meet expectations; high expectations; expectation of success
commonMistake: expectation 是名词，动词是 expect；常用复数 expectations 表示“期望”，不要把 expectation 与 experience 混淆。

example.english: The mission took longer than our original expectation.
example.chinese: 这次任务耗时比我们原先预期的更久。

application.prompt: The team had no ___ of finding water so soon, so the result surprised them. A. expect B. expectation
application.solution: B。解析：no 后需要名词 expectation，表示“没有预料到”；expect 是动词。

grammar: n. 技艺；工艺；船；飞行器
collocations: traditional craft; a small craft; craft a plan
commonMistake: craft 可指手工艺、船或飞行器；作“手工艺”时常用 crafts，作航天器等集合义时复数可仍为 craft。

example.english: The museum displayed a small craft used to carry supplies across the lake.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了一艘用于横渡湖面运送物资的小船。

application.prompt: A rescue ___ approached the island to bring food to the villagers. A. crafty B. craft
application.solution: B。解析：能运送物资的小船是 craft；crafty 意为“狡猾的”。

collocations: a spaceship crew; travel in a spaceship; design a spaceship
commonMistake: spaceship 通常指在太空航行的飞船；spacecraft 是范围更广的航天器，也可包括无人探测器。

example.english: The children built a model spaceship for the science fair.
example.chinese: 孩子们为科学展制作了一艘飞船模型。

application.prompt: In the story, the astronauts live and work aboard a large ___. A. spaceship B. space stationer
application.solution: A。解析：宇航员乘坐并生活其中的飞行器是 spaceship；space station 是空间站，space stationer 不是该词。

grammar: n. 调查；测绘；v. 调查；测量
collocations: conduct a survey; survey the land; survey results
commonMistake: survey 可作名词或动词；做问卷调查常用 conduct a survey，不能说 make a survey results。

example.english: The team surveyed the valley before choosing a landing site.
example.chinese: 团队先测绘了山谷，再选择着陆地点。

application.prompt: Researchers ___ the area to map its rocks and slopes. A. survey B. surveyor
application.solution: A。解析：句中需要动词 survey（测绘）；surveyor 是测量员。

collocations: be crowded with people; a crowded train; crowded streets
commonMistake: crowded 是形容词，常用 be crowded with；crowd 作名词指人群，crowded 不等于 busy（繁忙的）。

example.english: The observation deck was crowded with visitors at sunset.
example.chinese: 日落时，观景台上挤满了游客。

application.prompt: The launch hall was so ___ that we could hardly find a seat. A. crowd B. crowded
application.solution: B。解析：was 后需要形容词 crowded，说明大厅里人很多；crowd 是名词或动词。

collocations: operate a machine; the system operates automatically; operate on a patient
commonMistake: operate a machine 表示操作设备，operate on sb 表示给某人做手术；名词 operation，operator 指操作员。

example.english: The ground team operated the camera from a control room.
example.chinese: 地面团队在控制室里操作摄像机。

application.prompt: Only trained staff may ___ the telescope's moving platform. A. operate B. operation
application.solution: A。解析：may 后接动词原形 operate，表示“操作”；operation 是名词。
